scope: Historical native causal prefill/decode, GQA, residual preservation, bounded KV admission and HTTP/SSE incremental generation

independent_oracle.configuration: One layer, width 4, 2 query heads, 1 KV head, zero Q/K projections, V selecting first two normalized components, identity attention output, zero MLP, epsilon 3
independent_oracle.output: First four logits are hidden / sqrt(mean(hidden^2)+3); all other logits zero

failure_scope: Rejected input leaves the cache untouched; numerical failure may write uncommitted rows but does not advance position or alter committed rows. Retry overwrites uncommitted rows.
limitations: Full TinyLlama generation after these changes has not yet been recorded.
The optional --bml RPN projection/attention path still requires repair and separate validation.
No numerical parity with llama.cpp or modern bml-model is claimed by these closed-form tests.
Raw legacy KV storage methods retain ring-address semantics; causal callers enforce capacity before using them.
